tasks.title: 5. Meta app setup (yours)
tasks.detail:
YOUR STEPS — plain words, verified against Meta's official docs (2026-09-27):

BEFORE YOU START — check these two things:
• Your Instagram (@the_intelligently_artificial) is a Professional account (Business or Creator), not personal. Check in the Instagram app: Settings > Account type.
• That Instagram is linked to your Facebook Page, and your personal Facebook account is an admin of that Page.

REGISTER AS A DEVELOPER FIRST (you are here now):
1. Finish the signup on this page: verify your phone number (they text you a code), then contact info, then about you.
2. Only after that does the "My Apps" menu appear.

CREATE THE APP:
5. Go to developers.facebook.com and log in with your personal Facebook account.
6. Open My Apps, then Create app.
5. Enter an app name (e.g. "Intelligently Artificial Publisher") and your contact email.
6. When it asks for use cases, select BOTH:
   • "Manage messaging & content on Instagram" (lets the app publish to Instagram)
   • "Manage everything on your Page" (lets the app publish to your Facebook Page)
7. In the app dashboard, open the Instagram use case settings and make sure the permission instagram_business_content_publish is added and granted — this is the one that lets the app publish reels and posts.
8. In the Page use case settings, make sure pages_manage_posts is included — this lets the app publish to your Facebook Page.
9. In the app's Instagram settings, use Instagram login to connect your Instagram account and generate an access token. Copy it somewhere safe.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT:
• When you reply "done", I take it from there.
• I will ask you for the token (explaining exactly what it lets me do before you share it).
• Then I run the two publish tests: one video to your Facebook Page, one reel to Instagram — through your app.

NOTE:
• Meta's docs don't say outright whether an app publishing only to its owner's accounts needs App Review. If the dashboard asks you for App Review or business verification during setup, stop and tell me what it says before continuing.

tasks.title: 6. Facebook production publish test
tasks.detail: Publish a test video to the Facebook Page through the Graph API production path — the same mechanism intended for live publishing, not a stand-in. Needs the Meta app + Page token from the app setup.

tasks.title: 7. Instagram production publish test
tasks.detail: Publish a test reel to @the_intelligently_artificial through the Instagram Graph API production path (media container → publish). Needs the Meta app + IG permissions from the app setup.
